calls.title: GrowthBook Intro
calls.summary: The meeting focused on the introduction of A/B testing and experimentation strategies for improving conversion rates on the company's lease contract intermediary website. Achraf confirmed plans to test an AI search assistant and optimize call-to-action buttons to boost lead conversions among a monthly user base of about 100,000. Current metrics show a 1.89% conversion rate from visitors to leads, with potential for significant revenue uplift from experimentation. The company will employ a code-based experimentation approach using GrowthBook's SDK, utilizing stable user identifiers and SQL-based metrics for accurate evaluation. Coordination between engineering and data teams is essential to synchronize tracking and ensure reliable data flow, further supporting the company's goal of building a robust experimentation framework.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, GrowthBook integration, feature flags, CRM data, conversion tracking, experiment analytics
calls.action_items:

Evaluate GrowthBook free version and test potential integration with company tech stack and CRM (30:51)
